sententia, ægrè majoribus amplius nostris evelli potuit. Unde factum, ut cred-

debuerint Imperatorum privilegiis, immunitatem concedentibus. Primum,

suam Tigurì spargere cœpit doctrinam, quo inter alia Collegiatam Ecclesiam red-

page.notes: The page is printed in roman and italic type with a few lines in italic set entirely; the italic passages are marked as far as they could be seen. The signature "1 2" at the foot is uncertain. The text carries no marginal notes.
